zh.about.intro.title: 项目简介
zh.about.intro.p1: AGI（Alliance Graphique Internationale，国际平面设计联盟）成立于1951年，由全球顶尖平面设计师组成，致力于推动平面设计专业的国际交流与学术发展。
zh.about.intro.p2: 本站汇集AGI会员的代表性设计作品，以瀑布流方式向公众呈现当代平面设计的多元面貌，涵盖品牌、海报、书籍、字体、包装、导视等多个领域。数据来源于AGI（国际平面设计联盟）官方公开资料，所有作品版权归原作者及设计师所有，仅供学习交流使用，不得用于商业用途。
zh.about.intro.p3: 浏览时可按国家、类型、领域或设计师索引查找作品，支持关键词搜索、条件筛选、收藏与深色模式；打开作品灯箱可查看完整信息与多张图片，支持双指缩放与双击放大。
zh.about.usage.title: 使用说明
zh.about.usage.search.title: 搜索
zh.about.usage.search.text: ：支持标题、设计师、客户、标签等关键词；可叠加年份、国家、类型筛选。
zh.about.usage.index.title: 索引
zh.about.usage.index.text: ：按国家、类型、领域、设计师 A-Z 四类索引浏览；点击任一项返回首页查看对应作品。点Logo可回到全部作品。
zh.about.usage.fav.title: 收藏
zh.about.usage.fav.text: ：灯箱左上角 ♥ 收藏作品，收藏保存在浏览器本地，换设备不同步。
zh.about.usage.theme.title: 深色模式
zh.about.usage.theme.text: ：右上角汉堡菜单打开药丸，点太阳 / 月亮图标切换。
zh.about.usage.gesture.title: 手势
zh.about.usage.gesture.text: ：灯箱内双指缩放、双击放大，放大后可拖动。

en.about.intro.title: About
en.about.intro.p1: AGI (Alliance Graphique Internationale) was founded in 1951 and brings together the world's leading graphic designers, promoting international exchange and academic development of the graphic design profession.
en.about.intro.p2: This site gathers representative works by AGI members, presenting the diversity of contemporary graphic design through a masonry layout, covering branding, posters, books, typography, packaging, wayfinding and more. Data is sourced from the official AGI (Alliance Graphique Internationale) public materials. All works are copyrighted by their respective authors and designers, and are provided for study and exchange purposes only, not for commercial use.
en.about.intro.p3: Browse by country, type, sector or designer index, with keyword search, filters, favorites and dark mode. Open the lightbox to view complete information and multiple images, with pinch-to-zoom and double-tap-to-zoom.
en.about.usage.title: How to use
en.about.usage.search.title: Search
en.about.usage.search.text: : supports title, designer, client, tags and more; can combine with year, country, type filters.
en.about.usage.index.title: Index
en.about.usage.index.text: : browse by country, type, sector, or designer A-Z; tap any item to return to the homepage filtered. Tap the logo to return to all works.
en.about.usage.fav.title: Favorites
en.about.usage.fav.text: : tap ♥ in the lightbox to save. Favorites are stored locally in the browser (localStorage) and won't sync across devices.
en.about.usage.theme.title: Dark mode
en.about.usage.theme.text: : open the pill menu via the hamburger, then tap the sun / moon icon.
en.about.usage.gesture.title: Gestures
en.about.usage.gesture.text: : pinch to zoom, double-tap to zoom in; drag when zoomed.
